user_story: As a user, I want to manage my shopping cart so that I can view the items I intend to purchase and proceed to checkout. Acceptance Criteria: 1. The user can see the title 'Your Cart' displayed on the page (selector: [data-test='title']). 2. The user can see a button labeled 'Continue Shopping' (selector: [data-test='continue-shopping']). 3. The user can see a button labeled 'Checkout' (selector: [data-test='checkout']). 4. The user can view the cart contents displayed in a container (selector: [data-test='cart-contents-container']).
cypress_script: describe('Shopping Cart Functionality', () => { it('should display the shopping cart with items and allow checkout', () => { cy.visit('https://www.saucedemo.com/'); cy.get('[data-test="username"]').type('standard_user'); cy.get('[data-test="password"]').type('secret_sauce'); cy.get('[data-test="login-button"]').click(); cy.visit('https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html'); cy.get('[data-test="title"]').should('have.text', 'Your Cart'); cy.get('[data-test="continue-shopping"]').should('be.visible'); cy.get('[data-test="checkout"]').should('be.visible'); cy.get('[data-test="cart-contents-container"]').should('exist'); }); it('should not allow checkout when cart is empty', () => { cy.visit('https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html'); cy.get('[data-test="checkout"]').should('be.disabled'); }); });
playwright_script: import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'; test('Shopping Cart Functionality', async ({ page }) => { await page.goto('https://www.saucedemo.com/'); await page.fill('[data-test="username"]', 'standard_user'); await page.fill('[data-test="password"]', 'secret_sauce'); await page.click('[data-test="login-button"]'); await page.goto('https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html'); await expect(page.locator('[data-test="title"]')).toHaveText('Your Cart'); await expect(page.locator('[data-test="continue-shopping"]')).toBeVisible(); await expect(page.locator('[data-test="checkout"]')).toBeVisible(); await expect(page.locator('[data-test="cart-contents-container"]')).toBeVisible(); await page.goto('https://www.saucedemo.com/cart.html'); await expect(page.locator('[data-test="checkout"]')).toBeDisabled(); });
